lines.quote: The project I am most proud of is the digital beamforming pipeline I designed for a 64-element L-band phased-array receiver built for a maritime surveillance radar.
I wrote the pulse-compression and Doppler-processing kernels in C++ for the receiver’s processing board — a Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ SoC — under a hard per-pulse timing constraint of 10 microseconds.
Designed and maintained Arctos, a Python-based automated test framework used by three engineering teams at Nordkom for antenna pattern verification and hardware-in-the-loop regression testing.
Antenna pattern measurement and RF front-end calibration across the company’s L-band and C-band instrument product lines.
Developed and verified signal-processing algorithms for the C-band wind scatterometer payload delivered as part of the EORA PolarMet-SG programme.
Led a team of four engineers through the calibration-algorithm development and field-validation campaign for the PolarMet-SG wind scatterometer.
Co-authored two peer-reviewed papers in SESE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (2018 and 2021) on external-calibration methods for spaceborne scatterometers.
Italian citizen; have lived and worked across EU member states (Germany, Netherlands, Sweden) under EU freedom of movement since 2004.
All documentation, design reviews, and customer deliverables at Nordkom are in English.
